change.method: For each of the 96 upward-facing top faces on each slab, sampled the corresponding registered 2023 orthophoto pixel at its projected face centroid. Clear red-family samples retain Mayflower Red ACM; neutral, pale, and shadow samples use the pale neutral roof appearance. Face geometry and all side faces are unchanged.
change.uncertainty: The pixel colors describe only the 2023 orthophoto appearance. This is not a material survey. GIS comparison finds only about 56–57% of each slab top area overlaps FID 642, but the official building footprint is not an architectural roof plan and canopies may extend beyond it; R10 therefore does not trim or remove geometry.
